title: The Works of Edgar Allan Poe, Volume 1
author: Edgar Allan Poe
firstLine: By late accounts from Rotterdam, that city seems to be in a high state of philosophical excitement.
begins: After an appreciation, a preface and a Life of Poe, the first tale is The Unparalleled Adventures of One Hans Pfaall, which opens with the news of an astonishing event in Rotterdam.
happens: Eight tales. Hans Pfaall, a Rotterdam man in debt, flies a balloon to the moon. In The Gold-Bug, William Legrand and Jupiter decode a cipher and unearth Captain Kidd's treasure. In The Murders in the Rue Morgue, Dupin shows that an escaped orang-outang killed Madame and Mademoiselle L'Espanaye. The Mystery of Marie Roget has Dupin reason from newspaper accounts about a perfumery girl's death. The Balloon-Hoax reports an Atlantic crossing. A sailor in MS. Found in a Bottle is carried toward the South Pole. Four Beasts in One is set in Antioch under Antiochus Epiphanes. In The Oval Portrait a painter's young wife dies as he finishes her portrait.
